title: AITA For Making A "Single Person" Joke About Myself?
question: AITA For Making A "Single Person" Joke About Myself?
body:
So today at lunch I heard my friend say "I'm like the single mom of the group." (Don't ask) and I said "I'm the 40 y/o single mom of the group." (I've called myself that for about a year and a half by the way, and I don't recall her calling herself the single mom of the group even once before that)

Friend: I literally JUST said that

Me: I know...I'm saying I'm the 40 y/o single mom of the group

Friend: What, it's different because of the age? You don't even KNOW how single I am. I have a lot of trouble with boys, you dont even know what it's like to be single.

Me: *kinda pissed off but also confused* ...

Friend: So dont go around saying stuff like that

Me, quietly: Don't talk to me like you're my mom..

Friend: Don't talk to me at all!! * Yells something at me that I can't remember *

Me: ......

I honestly don't know why this happened. I was just making a joke that I've made hundreds of times before, but today it just set her off. Am I the asshole here?
